memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports low back pain radiating to left leg, worse on prolonged standing; able to walk 2 km with mild discomfort; ADLs independent.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal); no concerns.
falls: denies falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular (pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, orlistat 120 mg TID, cholecalciferol 60000 IU weekly x8, then 1000 IU OD); polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: denies low mood or anxiety; sleep interrupted by pain.
carers: mother, Mrs. Lakshmi Rao, provides occasional grocery help.
goal: "I want to walk without pain and return to delivering mail comfortably."

memories.author: D06

memories.author: D06
memories.text:

cognition: Mini-Cog repeated 4/5; stable.
falls: no falls; gait smooth; timed up-and-go 8 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (pregabalin 75 mg BD, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, orlistat 120 mg TID, cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD, diclofenac stopped); polypharmacy – consider Beers review.
mood: reports better sleep; denies depression.
carers: mother, Mrs. Lakshmi Rao, assists with medication box.
goal: "I wish to resume my full delivery route without leg numbness."

memories.text:
function: back pain minimal; able to walk 4 km without discomfort; weight 88 kg; waist 96 cm.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw abnormal) – positive screen; plan for detailed neurocognitive assessment.
falls: no falls in past year; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 4 regular (pregabalin 75 mg BD, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, orlistat 120 mg TID, cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD); not polypharmacy.
mood: reports occasional frustration with forgetfulness; denies depression.
carers: mother, Mrs. Lakshmi Rao, reminds him to take meds.
goal: "I hope to stay sharp and keep working as long as possible."
